qandeel.$description:
I-08B3.1-F2 — THE INCREASED-CONTRAST OVERRIDE, LIGHT APPEARANCE. I-08B3.1-B4R declared the shape of this context — 'an increased-contrast expression is an OVERRIDE of the appearance it applies to, not a third appearance' — and I-08B3.1-F1 filled it for dark and said the light one was F2's.

WHAT IS NOT IN THIS FILE IS MOST OF IT, AND THAT IS THE §18 RESULT. F1's increased-contrast context re-points two ALIASES: qandeel.analysis.relation and qandeel.control.functional move one rung up the frozen reading ramp, from tertiary to secondary. An alias is appearance-independent, so BOTH OF THOSE ARE ALREADY CORRECT IN LIGHT and are not restated here. F1's own thicker focus perimeter — a non-colour strengthening, 2 px to 3 px — is a dimension and is appearance-independent too. The light appearance inherits every one of them from the same file the dark appearance uses, which is what 'test that the same transformation laws still work' means when the laws are expressed as a graph.

THE SAME SEARCH, IN THE SAME ORDER, WITH ONE SIGN REVERSED. Lever 1 is ALPHA, because alpha moves no colour and therefore cannot give any hue a new relationship to any other: it carries 12 of 15 (world, layer, ring) cases past 3:1 — the same 12 of 15 it carries in dark, which is not a coincidence but the same ladder measured from the other end. Lever 2 is ONE lightness delta for all three layers, because a per-layer move would compress or expand the depth ladder, which is a change in the spatial reading rather than in visibility. In dark that delta is +0.011; here it is -0.008, and the sign is the whole difference: on a near-black ground a contour buys contrast by lifting, on a near-white one by deepening.

RESULT: worst contour 1.692:1 to 3.021:1. Layer spacing preserved EXACTLY at 0.0674 / 0.0738. The chroma ceiling does not move, so no hue becomes more insistent than another.

WHAT IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT, AND EACH ABSENCE IS THE SAME DECISION F1 MADE:
  · qandeel.world.fill and qandeel.surface.functional — not moved. Whitening the light World to #ffffff would gain 1.07x on tertiary ink and would cost the World its ability to hold a light, which is the requirement that fixed its lightness in the first place.
  · qandeel.identity.material — LIVING BRASS IS STATE-INVARIANT IN VALUE AND IN APPEARANCE (I-08B3.1-E1R). An accessibility setting is not an exception, and neither is an appearance.
  · qandeel.illumination.* — QANDEEL LIGHT is MEANING. Deepening it under increased contrast would make every meaning event louder in proportion to a setting, which is meaning derived from a preference.
  · qandeel.status.error.ink — #ad4739 reaches 4.84:1 against the light World and carries a glyph and a sentence besides. F2 does not add a second error colour for this mode any more than F1 did.
  · qandeel.state.disabled.ink — as in dark, the rest ink rises under this context and the disabled ink does not, so the availability gap WIDENS. Raising it would compress the one distance that carries unavailability.

lightness-near.$description: 0.4944 - 0.008. Derived by the search in tools/f2-derive.mjs, not chosen.

com.qandeel.freeze.why: DERIVED against today's chroma ceiling and today's ramp on the light ground. If either moves the search is re-run and this number changes, which is exactly why it may not be frozen. What it serves is that the setting RAISES the field rather than simplifying it: no contour is dropped, no layer removed, and the layer spacing is preserved exactly.

lightness-far.$description: 0.6356 - 0.008. This is the layer the search was for: its outermost contour in the Public world measured 1.692:1 by default.

stroke-alpha-multiplier.$description: ZERO MEANS 'IGNORE THE PER-WORLD ALPHAS AND DRAW AT FULL OPACITY' — F1's sentinel, unchanged, and for F1's reason: the three worlds have different alpha ladders, so a multiplier would reach 1.0 for each of them at a different point and give the setting a per-world reading it must not have.

com.qandeel.freeze.why: the SENTINEL is a contract statement rather than a magnitude, and it is appearance-independent: it says which mechanism runs, not what colour comes out.
